anipakavutti：＂အနိပကဝုတ္တိ（တိ）
[န+နိပကဝုတ္တိ]
ပညာဖြင့် အသက်မွေးခြင်း မရှိသော၊ ၂၁-ပါးသော မသင့်သော ရှာမှီးခြင်းဖြင့် အသက်မွေးခြင်းရှိသော၊ သူ။
CPD: a-nipaka-vutti , mfn., injudicious in life-conduct ( cf. nipaka & nipaka-vutti); Ps lll 4, 6 (an-esanāya jīvitaṃ pakappento ~i nāma hoti).

DOP: nipphatti f. [ S. niṣpatti; cf also BHS niṣpadi], the being brought about, accomplishment; complete accomplishment or mastery; success; completeness, perfection; ripening; issue, outcome ; Abh 912 (niṭṭhā ~iyaṃ); Ja I 262, 7 (sabbasippesu ~iṃ patvā); 344, 9 (tumhehi diṭṭhasupinānaṃ ~iṃ kathessāmī ti); II 221, 18 (hatthisippe ~iṃ pāpuṇi); 386, 17 (kathaṃ me manoratho ~iṃ gamissati); III 65, 15´ (kā nu kho bhante mama gati kā ~i bhavissatī ti pucchi); 430, 9 (tumhe mayā sutasaddānaṃ ~iṃ jānāthā ti); Vism 378, 4 (ijjhanaṭṭhena iddhi °-aṭṭhena paṭilābhaṭṭhena cā ti); Sv 442, 31 (dve gatiyo ti dve niṭṭhā dve ~iyo); Mp I 112, 20 (pātubhāvo ti uppatti ~i); Spk II 336, 4 (nibbānaṃ assa pariyosānaṃ ~i niṭṭhā ti); Pj I 218, 11 (tassa me kiccassa ~iyā bhavissatī ti); II 145, 13 (sassaṃ virūhati na milāyati ~iṃ gacchati); Ap-a 172, 21 (imassa sippassa ekībhāvābhirati ~i); Cp-a 194, 2 (vipāko ti ~i); Sadd 622, 21 (pho passa: ~i); 874,1 0* (khandhasaddassa ~iṃ); — anipphatti , f. , lack of success; failure to accomplish ; Ja I 456, 11 (tayā karontiyā ~i nāma natthi); Sp 1390, 1 ; — see also evaṃ-nipphattika ( sv evaṃ ), mahānipphattika ( sv maha[t] ).
CPD: a-nipphatti , f . = a-nipphāda ( q. v. ), Ja l 456, 11 .

anipuṇa.p:

See also Duṭṭhulla
a: မသိမ်မွေ့သော၊ မလိမ္မာသော၊ သူ။ ဒုဋ္ဌုလ္လ-လည်းကြည့်။

B:
anipuṇa：anipuṇa（ti）

anipuṇa：＂အနိပုဏ（တိ）
[န+နိပုဏ]
မသိမ်မွေ့သော၊ မလိမ္မာသော၊ သူ။ ဒုဋ္ဌုလ္လ-လည်းကြည့်။
DOP: nipuṇa mfn. [ cf S., BHS nipuṇa], 1. clever, skilful; subtle, acute ; Abh 721 (~o ca paṭu cheko); D I 26, 23 (samaṇabrāhmaṇā paṇḍitā ~ā; Sv 117, 7 : ~ā ti saṇha-sukhumabuddhino sukhuma-atthantare paṭivijjhana-jānanasamatthā); III 178, 4* (~ebhi vidūhi sabbhi vaṇṇitāni, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~ehi); M I 386, 29* (visāradassa ~assa bhagavato); A III 78, 20 (dullabho bhikkhave vuḍḍhapabbajito ~o); Sn 317 (viññū vibhāvī ~o ca hoti); Ja V 148, 18* (sevetha vaddhe ~e bahussute; 149, 11´ : ~e sukhumakāraṇajānanasamatthe); Ap 545, 6 (~ā cittakathikā); Vibh 426, 11* (dhīrā nipakā ~ā atthacintakā); Mil 22, 8* (bahussuto citrakathī ~o ca visārado); — 2. (what is) subtle, abstruse ; Abh 7 (nibbānaṃ … ~am anantam); Vin I 5, 10* (paṭisotagāmi ~aṃ gambhīraṃ duddasaṃ aṇuṃ); D I 12, 20 (dhammā gambhīrā duddasā … atakkāvacarā ~ā paṇḍitavedanīyā; Sv 99, 20 : ~ā ti saṇhasukhumasabhāvattā); Sn 1126 (pucchantā ~e pañhe); Th 26 (paccavyādhiṃ hi ~aṃ; Th-a I 89, 1 : ~an ti saṇhaṃ paramasukhumaṃ nirodha-saccaṃ catusaccam eva vā); Ja VI 362, 21* (yaṃ paṇḍito ~aṃ saṃvidheti); Nidd I 226, 30 (gambhīraṃ guyhaṃ ~aṃ paṭicchannaṃ … kathaṃ katheti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nipuṇṇaṃ); Mil 228, 20 (pañho ~o gambhīro); Dhp-a I 1, 13* (~ā atthavaṇṇanā); Th-a I 41, 12 (°-ttā); — anipuṇa , mfn. , not clever, not acute; not subtle ; Mil 239, 28 ; Sp 221, 10 (thūlaṃ ca asukhumaṃ, ~an ti vuttaṃ hoti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr anipunan ti); — atinipuṇa , mfn. , very clever, very acute ; Sv 936, 1 (~ā sukhumapaññā … manussā); — sunipuṇa , mfn. , very subtle; very acute ; Dhp 36 (sududdasaṃ ~aṃ … cittaṃ); Ap 327, 17 ; Mil 124, 2 (ayaṃ pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho sugambhīro ~o); 227, 28 (~o bhikkhu); — see also abhinipuṇa, nepuñña.
CPD: a-nipuṇa , mfn., ( a ) not clever; Mil 239, 28 ( m. ~o p'etaṃ sutvā attamano bhaveyya); — ( b ) in- delicate, low, vulgar; Sp l 221, 10 (n. thūlaṃ asukhu- maṃ ~ aṃ).
